note: Catalogue capture uplifted to the held tier-4 ST Engineering TERREX family brochure. Every value for the TERREX 1 column is grade claimed from the maker brochure, which publishes the gross vehicle weight, the payload, the dimensions, the engine, the power, the gearbox, the gear count, the road speed, the range, the approach and departure angles and the fording depth. The tier-5 English Wikipedia operating weight is replaced by the maker gross vehicle weight, from which the runtime derives the operating weight. The brochure publishes no tyre size and no ground clearance.
